base: origin/claude/accuracy a7c9581, merged with origin/claude/accuracy-baseline b708d67 and origin/claude/accuracy-money cb5348a (merge commits 651130d, 99e6b16)
summary: Merged the checker (baseline) and the money stage into claude/accuracy, made the checker read what the customer sees (shownOptions leaves out what the engine hides with an option_hidden warning; items read by kind), and recorded the counts after money in docs/accuracy/after-money/. Then rebuilt L18-L24 and L23b to the record: walls with no depth are 2x4 (3.5 in); existing insulation takes its room and a cavity with under 0.5 in left gets no product (cavity_full); walls use a new dense-pack bag row (122.5 sq ft x in, Greenfiber INS765, needs owner input) and dense-pack fills the room left; walls have their own cellulose waste cell (1.08, bounds 1.00-1.60); seven batt sizes R-11 to R-38 (needs owner input) picked by R and thickness so a batt always fits; an estimator's bag count changes what the item promises and is cut to a full cavity with an override_capped warning; the stated R never exceeds what the cavity holds; one R-per-inch table (lib/pricing/rPerInch.ts) for the engine, the photo read and the checker. Every record example the record gives inputs for is hit to the dollar (L18 $2,520, L19 no options and $1,500/$2,295, L20 31 bags $1,254+$186+$60 and 49 bags $2,090, S1-F9 $3,070, S1-F9b $2,900, wet walls $5,480, L22 R-21 $2,270, L23 R-4.1 and 60->31, L23b R-12.6 $1,500, synthetic S1-F4 $2,660, L24 R-36). Two fixes the checker found once items follow their quantities: an estimator's hours now scale from each option's hours for the quantities it prices (bags typed for every option are one price), and code and full-cavity sentences hold for every area they are about. The checker gained full_cavity_not_filled and qty_below_stated_r. 10,000 random quotes at seed 20261118: every money and cavity rule is 0 (labels 1,468 -> 0, cavity 4,654 -> 0 against the engine after money, same checker); same_price_text and valid_until remain for the next stage. Migration 20261119000001_accuracy.sql is additive; origin/main's default-material lookup still sees one material per product. All checks pass on 97b9795, including the full e2e (244 ok).
